title: Session restore never relaunches tray-icon-only (StatusNotifierItem) applications
line: Apps that only show a tray icon (no window) are now relaunched by "restore previous session" at the next login.
explanation: At logout plasma-fallback-session-save records the running apps by reading the task manager's window list. An app whose only interface is a tray icon has no window, so it was never recorded and the restore at login never started it. The change also asks the StatusNotifierWatcher for the registered tray items, maps each item's owning process to a .desktop file by comparing its command line arguments with the desktop file's executable, and saves it unless a window already saved it or it is in excludeApps.

commits.message:
session-restore: also save applications that only have a tray icon

Applications whose only interface is a tray icon have no window, so the
saved session never listed them and they were not started again. Also
save the owners of registered tray items, found by their command line.

BUG: 525807
